name: search_model
description: Returns CDS model definitions (CSN), including elements, annotations, parameters, file locations and HTTP endpoints. Useful for building queries, OData URLs, or modifying models.

name.description: Definition name (fuzzy search; no regex or special characters)

kind.description: Definition kind to filter by (e.g., service, entity, action)

namesOnly.description: If true, only return definition names (for overview)
